title: The Loudest Sound in History
description: In 1883 a volcano exploded so loudly it was heard 3,000 miles away. #shorts #science #history

segments.text: This sound was heard 3,000 miles away.
segments.say: This sound was heard three thousand miles away.

segments.text: August 27th, 1883. The volcano Krakatoa, in Indonesia, blew itself apart.
segments.say: August twenty seventh, eighteen eighty-three. The volcano Krakatoa, in Indonesia, blew itself apart.

segments.text: On an island near Africa, people heard what sounded like distant cannon fire. It came from the other side of the ocean.
Sailors on a ship 40 miles away had their eardrums burst.

segments.text: The pressure wave was so strong that barometers around the world recorded it passing seven times, over five days.
